localization.object_ids: Nonempty original compact/group integer aliases; no booleans, unknown IDs or ambiguous reuse.

classification.uncertainty: Array of nonblank strings; nonempty for uncertain or unknown.

separation: Source geometry, component role, observed label and content type are distinct. Classification does not establish caption association.
